data.narrative:
Basecamp Research is a Series B biotech company founded by Oliver Vince and Glen Gowers, having raised $85M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer set of 4 private companies in the Biotech & Health sector at Series B and Series C stages, alongside 3 public comparables (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L).

Two triangulation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.9x multiplier to the $85M total raised proxy, implying a valuation of $162M. Peer-median analysis anchors to the median valuation of four same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables: Colossal Biosciences ($10.3B), Chai Discovery ($3.8B), New Limit ($3.1B), and Eikon Therapeutics ($539M), yielding a median of $3.5B. Public comparables cannot be applied given the absence of revenue disclosure typical in private companies. The sector P/S median across public peers is 6.2x, but this requires revenue data not available.

The triangulated range is $137M (low) to $4.0B (high) with a median of $1.8B. The significant dispersion reflects material uncertainty: stage-progression conservatively floors the valuation at $162M, while peer-median anchors substantially higher at $3.5B, driven by later-stage comps commanding large valuations. Key uncertainties include Basecamp's position relative to peer quality, clinical stage advancement, and capital efficiency relative to the $539M–$10.3B peer range.
